title: Extraction and Cover
author: Paloma Hartwell
blurb: August Sterling, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
